policy: These are AI cross-review adjudications, not human or native-speaker review. Repairs overlay the immutable generated content without changing its source files, selected senses, catalog membership, or ELELex level assignments.

futureQualityTargeting.observation: The actionable definition repairs cluster in modern everyday vocabulary, especially food, clothing, sport, and leisure. The clearest concrete cases are sushi, camiseta, pollo, bañador, partido, senderismo, and cava.
futureQualityTargeting.action: For A2-C1, supplement broad QA with a deterministic targeted sample from these domains rather than relying on a purely random sample.
futureQualityTargeting.limitation: This pattern is a targeting signal from 14 AI-flagged A1 definitions, not a measured domain error rate.

entries.originalDefinition: Comida de arroz y pescado envuelta en algas.
entries.replacementDefinition: Comida japonesa hecha con arroz condimentado y otros ingredientes.
entries.rationale: The source synset is narrower than contemporary Spanish usage: sushi need not contain fish or be wrapped in seaweed.

entries.originalDefinition: Prenda ajustada sin abertura frontal que cubre la parte superior del cuerpo.
entries.replacementDefinition: Prenda para la parte superior del cuerpo, normalmente sin botones y de manga corta.
entries.rationale: A camiseta need not be close-fitting.

entries.originalDefinition: Llevar algo o a alguien hasta un lugar.
entries.replacementDefinition: Llevar algo o a alguien hacia quien habla o hacia un lugar de referencia.
entries.rationale: The direction toward the speaker or contextual reference point distinguishes traer from llevar.

entries.originalDefinition: Carne de gallina usada como alimento.
entries.replacementDefinition: Carne de un ave doméstica criada como alimento.
entries.rationale: The selected sense is specifically chicken meat. The bird meanings are separate supplied senses, so this entry remains meat-only; gallina was incorrectly narrower than pollo.

entries.originalDefinition: Prenda ajustada que se lleva para nadar.
entries.replacementDefinition: Prenda que se lleva para nadar o bañarse.
entries.rationale: Spanish bañador also covers loose swimwear.

entries.originalDefinition: Territorio urbano con gobierno local propio.
entries.replacementDefinition: Territorio administrado por un gobierno local propio.
entries.rationale: A municipio can include rural as well as urban territory.

entries.originalDefinition: Área concreta de trabajo elegida como profesión.
entries.rationale: The definition accurately expresses the selected career-specialization sense; broader senses of especialidad do not invalidate it.

entries.replacementDefinition: Rama del conocimiento basada en el estudio sistemático de una parte de la realidad.
entries.rationale: The replacement removes the circular dependence on científico while preserving the selected disciplinary sense.

entries.originalDefinition: Competición formal entre dos personas o equipos.
entries.replacementDefinition: Competición deportiva entre dos personas o equipos.
entries.rationale: The ordinary intended sense is a sports or game match and need not be formally organized.

entries.originalDefinition: Actividad de dar largos paseos por ejercicio o placer.
entries.replacementDefinition: Actividad de caminar por rutas o senderos en entornos naturales.
entries.rationale: The route and natural-environment component distinguishes senderismo from an ordinary long walk.

entries.originalDefinition: Actividad organizada para producir bienes y servicios destinados a la venta.
entries.replacementDefinition: Actividad económica organizada para fabricar o transformar productos.
entries.rationale: The selected manufacture sense requires a production or transformation component rather than commercial activity generally.

entries.originalDefinition: Persona que ama a alguien o recibe su amor.
entries.replacementDefinition: Persona que mantiene una relación amorosa con otra.
entries.rationale: Merely receiving love does not establish the contemporary noun sense; the relationship must be explicit.

entries.originalDefinition: Vino blanco con burbujas parecido al champán.
entries.replacementDefinition: Vino espumoso parecido al champán y elaborado principalmente en España.
entries.rationale: Cava can be white or rosé, so color is not defining.

entries.originalDefinition: Gran extensión de agua salada, parcialmente rodeada de tierra.
entries.rationale: Partial enclosure accurately describes the selected sea sense and distinguishes it from the separate ocean sense.
